headline: Late day 1: live losses are mostly direction, not cost (87% of trades are in setups that lose before costs); two more ideas closed, GATE2's pullback timing survives a fair test but is tiny.
bullets: Observer (16,615 live paper trades): 71 of 91 setups lose before costs; tight stops lose on direction, not fees. Every study must now show positive gross edge first.
CWT14SKIP closed: half its skipped trades were earnings days; without them t 1.05.
STOPW (minimum stop width) closed as a stop fix: 85% of its gain was simply trading smaller, and the stop effect loses on down days.
GATE2 pullback timing beats a matched random entry (t 4-32 in ATR units) but is only ~6-9bp per trade, below a round trip; one counted rework (mid-day exit / half size) must add gross edge.
Skeptic caught a look-ahead bug in Scout's near-high scan (HODSEP) before anything was built on it; re-run tomorrow.
next: Tomorrow: GATE2 rework plan (<= 4 configs), HODSEP re-run with the fix, book-wide 'extension vs pullback entry' check on live trades.
